types.title: Mechanical Reasoning
types.subtitle: Understand how systems move
types.description: Explore forces, motion, and the relationships between working parts.

types.title: Spatial Reasoning
types.subtitle: Think across shapes and space
types.description: Rotate, reflect, and assemble visual relationships in your mind.

subtypes.title: Dice Folding
subtypes.subtitle: Fold a six-face net
subtypes.description: Find which three-dimensional cube can or cannot be made from a flat net.

subtypes.title: Dice Unfolding
subtypes.subtitle: Open a marked cube
subtypes.description: Compare folded cube views with complete six-face nets.

subtypes.title: Cube Counting
subtypes.subtitle: Count a 3D structure
subtypes.description: Count every unit cube in a supported structure or three-view drawing.

subtypes.title: Perspective Viewing
subtypes.subtitle: Choose a fixed view
subtypes.description: Find the top, front, or left projection of a 3D object.

subtypes.title: Blocks Forming
subtypes.subtitle: Fit 3D pieces
subtypes.description: Choose the rigid blocks that assemble into the target volume.

subtypes.title: Jigsaw Forming
subtypes.subtitle: Complete a square picture
subtypes.description: Fit interlocking pieces and their line and polygon patterns into a square.

subtypes.title: Pattern Finding
subtypes.subtitle: Complete a visual sequence
subtypes.description: Infer the missing figure from movement, progression, rotation, and matrix rules.

subtypes.title: Pattern Fitting
subtypes.subtitle: Restore a continuous design
subtypes.description: Choose the exact piece that reconnects every contour, motif, and texture in a larger pattern.

subtypes.title: Which Does Not Belong?
subtypes.subtitle: Find the spatial exception
subtypes.description: Compare geometric figures and find the one that breaks their shared rule.

subtypes.title: Rule Determining
subtypes.subtitle: Decode shape operations
subtypes.description: Infer each geometric operator from examples, then trace a new string through the diagram.

types.title: Verbal Reasoning
types.subtitle: Find meaning and logic
types.description: Work through relationships, statements, and short passages.
